sources.note: Blinkit product page. The nutrition, ingredients, FSSAI licence, manufacturer and country of origin are the pack's mandated declarations under the FSS (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations, reproduced by the retailer. Read from the page's own labelled fields, never from its marketing copy. No price or availability is taken.

attributes.storage_instructions: Keep out of the sight and reach of children. Do not use this medicine after the expiry date. Store in a cool and dry place away from direct sunlight.
